notes.title: Update content:
notes.notes:
Update content: (Some time ago because the hard disk was broken to repair, so it has been unable to update.)
1. Entering a password in the 6 candles maze area can now make KunKun disappear, further reducing the difficulty.
2. Modified some sound effects and added a bit of hidden content.
3. Now the final chase will also have KunKun chase in simple mode, but the chase speed will be very slow. And it doesn't influence Endings whether it's hard or easy.

notes.title: Update:
notes.notes:
Update:

1. Added some scene details.

2. Partially modified the game process.

3. Significantly increased the movement speed of players and KunKun, making chase battles more intense and exciting.

4. Enriched the content and difficulty of stealth and chase battles with KunKun, while also setting up mechanisms to reduce difficulty.

5. Added 1 new End (out of 3 End) and a corresponding achievement.

notes.title: Small updates
notes.notes:
Adjusted some game sound effects.

Reduced the frequency of Jump Scare.

A certain area has been remade.

The third new ending is not yet done, and we will have to wait a little longer.

notes.title: Small updates
notes.notes:
The underground library has now added a KunKun on patrol，and you can avoid KunKun by hiding in the cabinet.
Adjusted some game details.
